blocks.task_summary: Show that k satisfies the equation 7k^3 = 6 given a piecewise probability density function f(x).
method_path: Set the integral of f(x) over all x equal to 1.
Integrate from 0 to k: ∫0k k x dx
Integrate from k to 2k: ∫k2k (2k - x)/(k) dx
Evaluate the integrals and simplify to obtain 7k^3/6 = 1, hence 7k^3 = 6.

evidence.basis: The markscheme shows the integral set-up, evaluation, and final result with A1 marks.

method_path: Recognize median m satisfies ∫0m f(x) dx = 0.5.
Compute ∫0k f(x) dx = 3/7 ≈ 0.428571, so m > k.
Set up equation ∫0k f(x) dx + ∫km (2k - x)/k dx = 0.5, or equivalently ∫m2k f(x) dx = 0.5.
Evaluate integral to obtain an equation in m, solve numerically for m, yielding m ≈ 1.03.
accepted_alternatives: Use the upper tail integral: ∫_m^{2k} (2k - x)/(k) dx = 0.5

evidence.basis: Markscheme shows recognition M1, k value and lower integral A1, then either integral setup A1, and final answer A1; also alternative upper tail method.
